title: product-context: deliberate per ledger, not a defect: The new ReportIfLocatedInCompilation filter drops every diagnostic whose location is not in a syntax tree of the compilation, so it also silences diagnostics with no location (Location.None). For a metadata type, MemberNeedsKey now gets a null location and is silently dropped. This is consistent with the documented behavior that diagnostics for referenced-assembly types are not reported by the consumer.
